channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Check the wallet network before a bridge deposit
item.description: A wallet network mismatch can stop a bridge deposit or send funds along the wrong route; check the source chain, token and destination before signing any transaction.

item.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow mainnet activation for Oct. 21
item.description: Solana will activate Alpenglow on mainnet on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond transaction finality, down from about 12.8 seconds.

item.title: Thor swap or bridge and trade: which route fits?
item.description: A cross-chain swap combines movement and conversion in one route; bridging first gives more control but adds steps, gas and destination-chain execution.

item.title: Jeonbuk Bank starts South Korea’s first bitcoin-backed loans
item.description: Jeonbuk Bank has begun won loans for companies backed by bitcoin, using an outside custodian and court sale procedures to recover collateral after default.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes decade-old flaw that could mint new XRP
item.description: XRP Ledger fixed a decade-old payment flaw that could have created spendable XRP beyond its 100 billion supply cap; developers found no public exploitation.

item.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody on XRP Ledger
item.description: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD on the XRP Ledger through its Dubai branch, opening the stablecoin to eligible institutional clients.

item.title: GSR commits $100 million to new onchain credit business
item.description: GSR is committing $100 million to Hare, a new onchain vault business launching Aave-based stablecoin and tokenized-gold yield products with anchor liquidity.

item.title: Meanwhile raises $37.5M in Bitcoin life insurer funding
item.description: Meanwhile raised $37.5 million from existing investors, taking its total above $180 million as it expands Bitcoin life cover through brokers serving clients outside the US.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes flaw that could mint spendable tokens
item.description: XRPL's Sept. 25 release fixed an overflow flaw that could mint spendable XRP; developers say they found no evidence of exploitation on public networks.

item.title: Solana cuts mainnet slot time to 200 milliseconds
item.description: Solana completed its move to 200ms slots on Oct. 9, doubling block production opportunities while Alpenglow remains a separate consensus upgrade in development.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates, commits $6 million to six
item.description: Fairshake will support 32 House candidates, including six receiving $1 million each, as the crypto industry turns to midterms after the CLARITY Act stalled.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC remittances on 82M US Galaxy devices
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet in late October for eligible users on 82 million US Galaxy devices, with bank payouts available in more than 60 countries.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates with at least $6 million
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for 2026, pledging $1 million each to six as the crypto industry’s market-structure bill remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: How to Compound SpookySwap Farm Rewards Into LP
item.description: Compounding SpookySwap farm rewards means harvesting BOO, converting the needed amount, adding liquidity to a chosen pair, then staking the LP tokens.

item.title: Solana Foundation launches DvP settlement program
item.description: Solana Foundation launched an open-source DvP program for atomic onchain settlement, with J.P. Morgan input and support for regulated token features.

item.title: Fairshake pledges $6 million to six House candidates
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, pledging $1 million each to six as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto policy unresolved.

item.title: Portal Bridge moves tokens across chains through Wormhole
item.description: Portal Bridge moves tokens between chains through Wormhole messaging, and the destination asset may be a wrapped version that must be redeemed on arrival.

item.title: Ondo launches private-market tokens with pre-IPO AI exposure
item.description: Ondo Finance introduced Ondo Private Markets on Oct. 5, offering notes tied to private-company value, with a pre-IPO AI market set to trade this week.

item.title: BNB Chain Token Trackers Need More Than a Familiar Symbol
item.description: BNB Chain trackers pair token symbols with contract addresses, prices and wallet activity; unusual Unicode can confuse searches, so verify the address before comparing charts or trading.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation launches private API payments with zkAPI
item.description: Ethereum launched zkAPI on Oct. 1, allowing users to pay for AI and other metered APIs with private credits while providers receive prompts without billing identities.
